statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41888 (GHSA-6pjf-3r9x-m592) is a registry-server authorization issue: DELETE /v2/<name>/manifests/<reference> can untag when storage.delete.enabled is false because tag deletion skips the deleteEnabled guard. argocd-image-updater links distribution/v3 only as an HTTP client to remote registries and does not run a distribution registry or execute that manifest handler path.

CVE-2026-41888 (GHSA-6pjf-3r9x-m592) is a registry-server authorization issue: DELETE /v2/<name>/manifests/<reference> can untag when storage.delete.enabled is false because tag deletion skips the deleteEnabled guard. argocd-image-updater links distribution/v3 only as an HTTP client to remote registries and does not run a distribution registry or execute that manifest handler path.
Same as CVE-2026-35172: distribution/v3 major version bump blocked in devfile-gem.

Affects distribution/v3 in the devfile gem Go binary. Fix requires a major version bump (v3.0.0-pre → v3.1.0+) which is incompatible with the devfile-gem module's dependency tree. Awaiting upstream devfile-gem to widen the constraint.
Same as CVE-2026-35172: distribution/v3 major version bump blocked in devfile-gem.

Affects distribution/v3 in the devfile gem Go binary. Fix requires a major version bump (v3.0.0-pre → v3.1.0+) which is incompatible with the devfile-gem module's dependency tree. Awaiting upstream devfile-gem to widen the constraint.

Affects distribution registry blob storage when storage.cache.blobdescriptor uses redis and storage.delete.enabled is true, allowing revoked repo-local reads to return after peer-repo activity. This image does not run a distribution registry or that redis-backed storage backend.

Affects distribution registry pull-through cache proxy auth when an operator configures an upstream registry; credentials can be sent to an attacker-controlled realm URL. This image runs only the argocd-image-updater controller, which uses distribution/v3 as a client library and does not run a distribution registry or that proxy flow.
